text: [image: Building a Strong Economy illustration] Building a Strong Economy A quarter of American workers need a license just to work, with no safety benefit and a real cost to interstate mobility. Lydia will push for license recognition across state lines, faster federal permitting for manufacturing, and clearing federal barriers holding back industries like hemp, so Michigan's economy isn't locked into industries on their way out. [image: Fighting Mass Surveillance and Technofeudalism: A Bill of Digital Rights illustration] Fighting Mass Surveillance and Technofeudalism: A Bill of Digital Rights Lydia will fight warrantless surveillance of Americans' communications, dismantle the license plate reader dragnet, and introduce a Bill of Digital Rights making your data your property. Read More

[image: Restoring Net Neutrality illustration] Restoring Net Neutrality Your internet provider can currently block websites, slow them down, or sell fast lanes, deciding what you can see and say online, and Michigan has no law stopping it. Past net neutrality bills failed because they imported outdated telephone-monopoly regulation and one-party support. Lydia will introduce a federal law that bans those three practices directly, applies to mobile internet, and gives people a real way to enforce it. Read More
